newsitem.title: JAPAN: Shares in Japan construction sector fall in Tokyo.
newsitem.headline: Shares in Japan construction sector fall in Tokyo.

text.p: Shares in Japan's construction sector softened in early Tokyo trading on Wednesday on a gloomy business outlook for the sector, brokers said.

As of 0041 GMT, Kumagai Gumi Co Ltd had fallen two yen to 153 yen, Hazama Corp was down 11 yen at 204, becoming the second-biggest percentage loser on the first section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange. The third-biggest loser was Haseko Corp, which fell six yen to 137 yen.

Fears about the financial health of construction firms were fuelled by this month's business failure by Tokai Kogyo Co Ltd . Tokai Kogyo shares, to be delisted from the bourse later this year, fell one yen to 9 as of 0057 GMT.

"With the money seen coming in from pension funds, buying is heading towards companies enjoying good earnings. Companies who expect poor earnings, on the other hand, are sold. We are seeing yet another two-tier trend in the market," said an official at a leading Japanese brokerage.
Others noted that some investors were selling construction shares and instead buying blue chips.
